record.body:
## Evidence

Expected: the committed store snapshot of the composer schema moves to 1.1.0 with the placement type. Observed: the phase diff 9e2ace02d..25a389b24 has no file under .canon/schemas/.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the snapshot reaches the landing branch or a human clears the finding. CI checks the snapshot, so a pull request without it would fail.

## Follow-up

Answer Needs you: commit the store changes, including the snapshot, on the landing branch.

payload.basis: The phase diff has no file under .canon/schemas. The snapshot change sits uncommitted in the main checkout.
payload.claim: spec-gap on placement-schema: the composer schema snapshot .canon/schemas/composer.json is not in the phase branch
payload.invalidated_when: the snapshot is committed on the branch that lands, or a human clears it

record.subject: review-placement-schema-spec-gap
